title: The Unstoppable Power of Time

scenes.label: RELATIVE TIME
scenes.text: Time is relative and can be affected by gravity and motion

scenes.label: SHORT TIME
scenes.text: The shortest unit of time is the yoctosecond, which is 1/1,000,000,000,000,000 of a second

scenes.label: LONG SLEEP
scenes.text: The longest recorded time without sleep is 264.4 hours, set by Randy Gardner in 1964
Follow so you never run out of fun facts.

description: Discover the unstoppable power of time, from relative time to the shortest units of time. Follow us for more!
